01
Real Identity

Every face is a real human.

Face authentication at signup binds one person to one profile — for life. No bots. No catfish. No second account. The web's first network where everyone is provably real.

0% Verified Human
  • Biometric registration — duplicates impossible
  • Liveness detection blocks photos & deepfakes
  • Your face is your key — nothing to steal

02
Soul Matching

Your personality, decoded.

A few playful questions a day, plus how you actually behave, build your Soul DNA across eight dimensions. The AI surfaces people you'll genuinely click with — not whoever's nearby.

0% Soul Match
  • 8 dimensions — empathy, humor, ambition, loyalty…
  • Learns continuously as you use the app
  • Matches feel eerily right, not random

03
Visual Discovery

See someone? Find them.

Met a person at a café, a flight, an event? Point your camera. Soulink finds their profile in seconds — no awkward "what's your handle?" The magic moment that makes people tell five friends.

0Seconds to Lock
  • Live camera search against real profiles

  • Turns real-world moments into connections

04
Argument Referee

Every conflict gets a fair verdict.

Disagreement with a friend? Open a Case. Both sides submit, the AI weighs it and delivers a structured, neutral verdict in 60 seconds. Share it anonymously, the community votes — and the loop goes viral.

0Seconds to Verdict
  • Hears both sides — text or voice
  • Neutral, structured, ends the loop
  • Anonymous verdicts fuel a viral feed

Everything inside Soulink

A complete social app, made for how India connects.

Beyond the four forces, Soulink already does everything a social app should, and a few things only Soulink does. It runs today on phones and laptops.

Trust & safety

Real people only

  • Face-verified signup, one face, one account
  • No messages without a connection, not even an invite note
  • Report & hide: comments flagged by many disappear
  • Private account, blocking and who-can-find-me controls
  • Time management: daily limits and break reminders
Connect

Meet the right people

  • Soul Score between every two people
  • Connect with intent: friendship, dating or anything between
  • Accept, Reject or Hold, with a reminder before it ends
  • Follow creators separately from connecting
  • Premium message: one paid note to someone new
Create

Sparks short videos

  • Five worlds: Travel, Cooking, Acting, Fitness, News
  • Open Mic Stage: a weekly theme and real open mics nearby
  • Casting Board: post a role, get video auditions
  • Spread around: boost a Spark by city and age
  • Spark Studio to edit before posting (below)
Share

Posts & Moments

  • Photo and video posts with likes, comments and replies
  • Scheduled reveal: post now, blurred with a countdown
  • Moments (stories) for your people
  • Indian music on posts, Moments and Sparks
  • Soul Shop: Soulink jackets, shoes and bands in 3D
Talk

Chat without barriers

  • One-to-one and group chats with one Groups page
  • Translator for text and voice across Indian languages
  • Voice notes, photos and reactions
  • Soulmoji: stickers made from your own face
For brands

Reach India's youth

  • Sponsored posts between Home posts
  • Spark ads: full-height video between Sparks
  • Sponsored Argue: a brand's topic people debate
  • Campus events and Open Mic challenges
  • Ads Manager with views and clicks per campaign
Spark Studio · edit like a pro, right in the browser
